from billing.storage import load
from billing.invoice import build_invoice
from billing.report import monthly_report

catalog, customers, orders = load()

# 1. Same invoice built twice in a row must be identical
o = next(x for x in orders if x.id == 'O-1002')
a = build_invoice(o, catalog, customers['C1'])
b = build_invoice(o, catalog, customers['C1'])
print('repeat build identical:', a == b, a.discount_cents, b.discount_cents)

# 2. Build every invoice in reverse order, then compare to forward order
fwd = {x.id: build_invoice(x, catalog, customers[x.customer_id]) for x in orders if not x.refunded}
rev = {x.id: build_invoice(x, catalog, customers[x.customer_id]) for x in reversed(orders) if not x.refunded}
print('order-independent:', fwd == rev)

# 3. Report revenue == sum of individually built invoices
rep = monthly_report(orders, catalog, customers)
total = sum(s.revenue_cents for s in rep.values())
manual = sum(i.subtotal_cents - i.discount_cents for i in fwd.values())
print('report total matches:', total == manual, total, manual)
"

cd . && python -m billing.cli report && echo "--- cross-check: report vs isolated per-invoice sums ---" && python - <<'EOF'
from billing.storage import load
from billing.invoice import build_invoice
from billing.report import monthly_report

catalog, customers, orders = load()
rep = monthly_report(orders, catalog, customers)

# Recompute each month from scratch, one invoice at a time, in a fresh list each time.
expected = {}
for o in sorted(orders, key=lambda i: (i.placed_on, i.id)):
    m = o.placed_on.strftime("%Y-%m")
    e = expected.setdefault(m, {"invoices": 0, "revenue": 0, "discount": 0, "tax": 0, "refunded": 0})
    if o.refunded:
        e["refunded"] += 1
        continue
    inv = build_invoice(o, catalog, customers[o.customer_id])
    e["invoices"] += 1
    e["revenue"] += inv.subtotal_cents - inv.discount_cents
    e["discount"] += inv.discount_cents + sum(l.discount_cents for l in inv.lines)
    e["tax"] += inv.tax_cents

ok = True
for m, e in expected.items():
    s = rep[m]
    got = {"invoices": s.invoices, "revenue": s.revenue_cents, "discount": s.discount_cents,
           "tax": s.tax_cents, "refunded": s.refunded_orders}
    match = got == e
    ok &= match
    print(f"{m} {'OK ' if match else 'MISMATCH'} {got}")
print("ALL MATCH" if ok else "MISMATCH FOUND")

# Also confirm no cross-invoice leakage: same order priced alone vs in a batch
o = next(x for x in orders if x.id == "O-1012")
alone = build_invoice(o, catalog, customers[o.customer_id])
print("O-1012 alone:", alone.subtotal_cents, alone.discount_cents, alone.tax_cents)
EOF
